profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: A diligent, fast learner offering the ability to assess an organization’s needs and create an interdependent, robust web presence. Experienced in all 5 stages of the web development process including: research, planning design, development, testing and delivery and maintenance. Also contains knowledge and skills in a wide array of scripting languages and multimedia tools.
